title: Set up AI governance and policy
summary: Using AI safely needs clear rules: who approves AI uses, how risks are assessed and how people stay in control. Set them up before AI spreads across the organisation.

beginner: Find out what AI rules your organisation already has.
Agree who approves new AI uses.
Set a simple risk check for each new use, including personal data.
Decide where human review is required.
Publish the rules in plain language.
intermediate: Use a recognised risk framework to shape the checks.
Require a data protection impact assessment where personal data is used.
Keep a register of AI uses and their owners.
experienced: Set AI policy across the organisation with legal and security leaders.
Review the policy as rules and technology change.
Report AI risks to senior leaders regularly.

canDelegateTo.task: Draft the policy and risk checks

toolExamples.confluence: Publish the AI policy and the register of AI uses.
toolExamples.jira: Track approvals for new AI uses.

pitfalls: No owner for each AI use

sources.title: Guidance on AI and data protection (ICO)
